name: Payment
description: Entity class that represents payment transactions in the system with all necessary attributes

fields.name: id
fields.description: Primary key for the payment record

fields.name: transactionId
fields.description: Unique identifier for the payment transaction from the payment gateway

fields.name: orderId
fields.description: Associated order ID

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Amount of the payment

fields.name: currency
fields.description: Currency code for the payment

fields.name: status
fields.description: Status of the payment (e.g., PENDING, COMPLETED, FAILED, REFUNDED)

fields.name: paymentMethod
fields.description: Method used for the payment

fields.name: gatewayResponse
fields.description: Raw response from the payment gateway

fields.name: createdDate
fields.description: Date when the payment record was created

fields.name: lastUpdatedDate
fields.description: Date when the payment record was last updated

name: PaymentMethod
description: Entity class that represents saved payment methods for users such as credit cards or digital wallets

fields.name: id
fields.description: Primary key for the payment method

fields.name: userId
fields.description: ID of the user who owns this payment method

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of payment method (e.g., CREDIT_CARD, DEBIT_CARD, PAYPAL)

fields.name: cardNumber
fields.description: Masked card number (for card payment methods)

fields.name: cardExpiryMonth
fields.description: Card expiration month (for card payment methods)

fields.name: cardExpiryYear
fields.description: Card expiration year (for card payment methods)

fields.name: gatewayToken
fields.description: Token provided by the payment gateway for stored payment methods

fields.name: isDefault
fields.description: Flag indicating if this is the default payment method for the user

fields.name: createdDate
fields.description: Date when the payment method was created

name: PaymentGatewayConfig
description: Configuration class that sets up the payment gateway connections and API keys in a secure manner

fields.name: apiKey
fields.description: API key for the payment gateway

fields.name: apiSecret
fields.description: API secret for the payment gateway

fields.name: gatewayUrl
fields.description: URL endpoint for the payment gateway

fields.name: encryptionService
fields.description: Service for encrypting and decrypting sensitive payment data

methods.name: gatewayClient
methods.description: Creates and configures the payment gateway client with the necessary credentials

methods.name: getDecryptedApiKey
methods.description: Retrieves and decrypts the API key for the payment gateway

methods.name: getDecryptedApiSecret
methods.description: Retrieves and decrypts the API secret for the payment gateway

name: PaymentServiceApplication
description: Spring Boot application entry point for the Payment Service module

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main method that launches the Spring Boot application

name: PaymentRequestDTO
description: Data Transfer Object that encapsulates the details required to process a payment request

fields.name: orderId
fields.description: ID of the order being paid for

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Amount to be paid

fields.name: currency
fields.description: Currency code for the payment

fields.name: paymentMethodId
fields.description: ID of the saved payment method to use (optional)

fields.name: cardDetails
fields.description: Credit card details if not using a saved payment method

fields.name: savePaymentMethod
fields.description: Flag indicating whether to save this payment method for future use
